newsitem.title: UK: LME metals end mostly lower, but aluminium higher.
newsitem.headline: LME metals end mostly lower, but aluminium higher.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Closes steadier, with market eyeing news that some Russian plants may consider cutting production.
COPPER - Ends steady, off highs above $1,970 on profit-taking.
NICKEL - Closes easier, rebuffed at $7,200 level.
LEAD/ZINC - Both track backwards to end kerb easier.
TIN - Tags along with copper, ends lower. ALLOY - Slack.
